Good morning,

Apologies for the delay.

For monthly stays, we can offer a final rate of AED 7,500 for 30 nights. Additionally, we can extend this same rate for up to 3 months if you wish to proceed.

Kindly let us know if you would like to confirm the booking. Please also note that a refundable security deposit of AED 3,000 is required.
